## Why This Is Asked
Tests ability to design an end-to-end, event-driven AWS flow using common primitives (S3, Lambda, DynamoDB) with EXIF parsing and simple geolocation logic, plus privacy and cost considerations.

## Key Concepts
- S3 event triggers and Lambda invocation
- Image EXIF extraction (Pillow) and GPS parsing
- Lightweight geolocation mapping (lat/long to city)
- Sidecar metadata storage in S3 and DynamoDB upserts
- IAM least privilege, error handling with DLQ, auditing, privacy controls, cost tuning

## Code Example
```python
from PIL import Image
from PIL.ExifTags import TAGS

def extract_exif(path):
    img = Image.open(path)
    exif = img._getexif() or {}
    data = {TAGS.get(k): v for k, v in exif.items() if k in TAGS}
    return data.get('Model'), data.get('DateTime'), data.get('GPSInfo')
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you handle missing EXIF or GPS data?
- How would you test the end-to-end with mocked S3 events and DLQ behavior?

## Why This Is Asked
This question evaluates building a low-latency, compliant fraud-detection pipeline with streaming data, model hosting, and integration patterns.

## Key Concepts
- Real-time ingestion with Kinesis Data Streams
- SageMaker Inference endpoints (transformer-based models)
- DynamoDB data modeling and TTL
- Step Functions orchestration and alerts
- IAM, KMS, and privacy controls
- Model drift monitoring (SageMaker Model Monitor)
- Cost governance and autoscaling

## Code Example
```javascript
const AWS = require('aws-sdk');
const sagemaker = new AWS.SageMakerRuntime();
async function score(event){
  const resp = await sagemaker.invokeEndpoint({EndpointName:'FraudDetector', Body: JSON.stringify(event), ContentType:'application/json'}).promise();
  return JSON.parse(resp.Body.toString());
}
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you implement canary deployments and drift monitoring for the endpoint?
- How would you validate data retention and privacy controls across regions?
